title: Customers cannot add items to the cart
scenario: You have joined the Flipkart web team. A bug has been reported against the product listing page.
symptom: Customers click Add to cart and nothing happens. The cart stays empty and no error appears.
hints: Open the Network panel after clicking Add to cart, and look closely at the shape of the response body for POST /api/cart.
CartContext.jsx reads the response with data.items. Does that key actually exist on what the server sent back?
The cart items the server returns live one level deeper than where the code is currently looking for them.

rubric.description: The cart list is populated from the cart.items array in the response body, not from a top-level items field.
After clicking Add to cart, the added product appears in the cart list instead of the empty-cart message.
The cart contents are derived from the API response: no literal product data is written into the component, and the POST request to /api/cart still happens and its result is still used.

The header cart-count badge is still derived from the same cart items state the cart list uses, and not from a separate count source. This criterion is about where the badge gets its number from only; whether those items are the right items is covered by the other criteria.
